known_difference.why: a program with no defs: Object.keys(undefined) throws
a number is no program: (5).defs is undefined
null is no program: null.defs throws
an array is no program: [].defs is undefined
an agent with no caps: undefined.flatMap throws
an agent with no skills: Object.values(undefined) throws
a skill that is null: null.budget throws
a tier of the lock that lists null: null.model throws; the Rust reads it as listing nothing, so the policy lists only the models it can read
